text:
Maya: Heads up — saw a customer report that the console quota dashboard showed Org B's token usage under Org A. Screenshot attached. not great.

Alex: ack, can you paste the screenshot? which route/model?

Maya: https://example.com/screenshot.png route /api/v1/usage/topline model=redwood-3b. reproduced locally by switching org header.

Sam: reproducing now. quick repro:
```
curl -H "X-Org-ID: org-A" https://console.internal/api/metrics?range=30d
```
and we get a block with org-B's numbers. Looks like cache key isn't using org header.

Lina: middleware returns cached blob from memcache with key `console:route:metrics:window:...` — missing org id. WIP patch in PR 4321 adds org to key. But need canary.

Alex: timeline — how many customers affected? any PII? runbook?

Maya: likely limited to telemetry counts. no PII in the payload, only usage counts and org names in the blob. CS alerted. flagged as high-priority.

Sam: here's the memcache GET/SET traces:
```
GET console:route:metrics:window:30d:scope:global
SET console:route:metrics:window:30d:scope:global <blob>
```
We should put org id after scope.

Lina: also observed CDN edge sometimes strips `x-org-id` on prefetch requests. So two vectors: cache key and missing header on edge. Adding both fixes.

Alex: plan: 1) patch middleware to include org id in cache key (PR 4321) 2) add header passthrough rule on CDN (ticket CDN-998) 3) invalidate affected cache entries 4) canary rollout to 5% 5) monitoring alert for cache key mismatches.

Sam: infra-bot: purge prefix console:route:metrics:window:. Done — ~1.2k keys removed.

deploy-bot: started canary deploy of eng-platform@patch-4321 to 5% of console instances.

Maya: once canary looks good, roll to 100%. also add telemetry event when a cache hit occurs without org id.

Lina: coding patch now. making cache key format: `console:metrics:{org}:{route}:{window}` -- will include fallback for legacy keys.

Alex: assigned to Lina and Sam. Set PM/CS update cadence.

Sam: quick Q — do we need to backfill telemetry for customers who saw wrong numbers? CS asked. We should export audit logs for the window and reconcile. I'll run query.

Maya: CS will reach out to affected accounts with explanation + apology. No billing impact expected.

Alex: nice. Also add e2e test to ensure cache key uses org header. Add a short postmortem to incidents channel after wrap-up.

deploy-bot: canary healthy after 12m. No errors. Rolling to 50%.

infra-bot: CDN rule applied to staging; waiting on prod rollout approval.

Sam: done — prod CDN rule applied, tests pass.

Maya: closing loop: root cause = missing org id in memcache key + occasional header stripping at CDN. Preventative: lock step test for header propagation + unit test for cache key. Thx.
